C2 · COME ON UPSTAIRS · 60 S Norwood, Hillsdale
First second voice the account has ever had.
Captions are machine-generated. Read them before you ship.

HANDOFF TO JON RUTAN
He is filmed here, not just mentioned. Being named in the
July team post is not consent to appear on camera. Ask him.

DEAD AIR CUT
7s of stair-climbing with nothing said removed here.

THE WINDOW LINE IS THE REEL
“We kept the window in the bathroom just because of the
aesthetics on the outside of the house.” Protect this beat.
Ends before “Beautiful, Jon.” Needs end card and music.
